limits: Early prefix is not a PDMS/NAVTEST result or proof of stable final training.
Teacher slots from the same collection are reused across four inner updates; gradient calibration has its own local slot clock.
Most gradient fields are averaged over leaves with missing keys zero-filled; conditional correction is stated, not raw state reconstruction.
Local per-component norms and DDP total norm differ in reduction; neither loss scalars nor norm ratios establish update-direction dominance.
No runtime/config/run/owner changes or new GPU/scoring queries from this analysis.

query_cost.extra_G32_legacy_label: conditional extra independent G16 teacher pool; not a true batch32 operator

relation_to_TRAIN19: TRAIN19 fixed IL70 probe found strict-high in12/15 zero scenes for each independent G16/G32, union13; all91 sampled high had positive rawA.
S6 now measures true same-version B1 and can directly supervise verified sampled high into B1 last state/CFM; activation is evidence of implementation use, not evidence of improved B1 after training.
Unlike old S1, S6 starts at epoch0 and also admits already-strict-high B1 with gain>=.005 at alpha.02; nonstrict repair uses gain>=.02 at alpha.05.
S6 conditional extra pool is an independent G16; legacy extra_G32 naming must not be equated with the true batch32 TRAIN19 numerical experiment.
TRAIN GT audit is separate: no GT target or NAVTEST label enters this live S6 material.
scalar_metric_denominators: budget_delta is known zero when no active teacher and is zero-filled across all rank/update rows; conditional gradient fields have separate active-slot denominators

adaptive_extra.trigger: nominalB1 notstrict-high AND no strict-high candidate in firstG16; gain is not part of trigger

source_protocol.budget: replace original beta50 IL share: .05 when B1 not strict-high, .02 when B1 strict-high; .75CFM+.25actualODElast

calibration.PG_EMA_initialization: first strictly positive actual PG norm

calibration.clock: eligible per-rank teacher-slot loss calls, including inner reuse; not Adam updates
calibration.cold_start: PG and PG EMA both zero: minimum scales, probe again next call, no eligible/calibration/measurement budget consumed
calibration.freeze: after100 eligible calls freeze scales; diagnose to500 eligible calls, then hold last measurements and PG EMA
calibration.gradients: all current trainable parameters; local norms, no cross-rank collective; no .grad mutation

source_protocol.initialization: same complete IL70, fresh Adam0/RNG42; never import an RL checkpoint
source_protocol.sampling: first full TRAIN epoch uniform; existing own-run TRAIN-only priority thereafter; never NAVTEST tokens/labels
source_protocol.teacher: actual same-scene/current-version strict NC/DAC/TTC/Comfort1, PDMS>=.9; repair gain>=.02, already-strict-high B1 gain>=.005
